title: Cell Profile
description: Envelope returned by GET /cells/{Cell_ID}/profile. Every repository answers the same shape with its own payload: same cell identity everywhere, different semantics everywhere. Geometry never travels with a profile -- a consumer that needs the cell drawn asks the geometry authority for it, so domain repositories neither fetch nor duplicate canonical geometry.

certification_state.description: Inherited from the geometry authority's transform. A consumer must not present a PROVISIONAL cell as a certified location.
